heat_credit: On the CHP-labelled low tranche only: (0.5 / existing electrical efficiency) * (monthly gas EUR/MWh_th + applicable carbon EUR/t * 0.198) / 0.9. No credit on flexible or non-CHP capacity. No startup/forecast or evaluation-price input.
tranche_status: 25% and 50% of geographically matched source CHP capacity are predeclared structural sensitivities, not measured minimum output or heat schedules. Useful heat efficiency 0.5 and boiler efficiency 0.9 are explicit proxies; no heat is forced and offers may be curtailed.
carbon: Oil and its hypothetical displaced gas boiler only: EEX successful T3PA primary-auction same-date volume-weighted price, carried to following UTC days. First 6 days keep EUR80/t. Last 16 days carry 15 December auction. This is retrospective auction-price proxy, not daily secondary spot or day-ahead-known information.
other_carbon: Keep inherited EUR80/t outside declared EU/EEA set. Shared IE-SEM supply retains source-country weights; GB units in Northern Ireland are unresolved. This experiment is not a complete UK/other-jurisdiction tax correction.
fuel: Daily EIA Brent / daily ECB with inherited explicit 1.7 MWh thermal/barrel; existing first-day fallback retained. No unsupported delivered-product or efficiency correction.
capacity: Retain audited source-backed PL/SK/SI additions and all current total hourly oil envelopes; split CHP proportions by source plant parent/location and current refined-bus capacity. Unknown roles and unlocated plants receive no heat credit. Reserve eligibility remains unresolved; no blanket removal or discount.
fixed: All non-oil bids, demand, renewable availability, fixed hydro, GSK, topology, HVDC, branch ratings and fitted coefficients remain frozen.
evaluation: All 8760 hours and 41 eligible price areas; known-hour ENTSO-E B06 quantities for DE/BE/PL/SK/SI, retaining missing hours. Report annual/monthly/hourly errors, active/negative-price hours and adverse effects. No generation or price target enters bid construction; no automatic best-case/baseline promotion.
gates: Every new annual must be complete/optimal with zero emergency, primal/native residual <=1e-4 MW, objective/duality error <EUR0.05. Independent source, two-tranche conservation, country allocation and full-year KKT replay before result claims. Bid objective with heat credits is not reported electricity-only fuel expenditure or complete system heat cost.
